experiment: Q2_0 fixed route-ranked 5000-slot Strata versus strict NInfer screen
device: Jetson AGX Orin orin1, aarch64, SM87, CUDA 12.6
hypothesis: With a fixed identical resident map covering more than 85% of this workload's routed experts, NInfer's active-resident path may show an API decode benefit without adaptive-map variation.
primary_metric: decode tokens/s; three-pair screen only; >=5% median effect and interval excluding zero required before confirmation

route_profile.trace_origin: two requests (one warmup and one measured) with the exact held-out workload and adaptation disabled; route dump was not timed
route_profile.interpretation: workload-oracle resident profile; not deployable or held-out profile evidence

workload: NIMBUS-7319 retrieval, 512 prompt tokens, 128 generated tokens; one warmup and one measured request per fresh process
controls: same binary, model, PLE pack, route-ranked profile, resident slot count, context, prefill, workers, memory reserves and request; adaptive swaps disabled in both arms; only backend selection differs
telemetry: one-second available-memory and swap sampling, cgroup OOM counter, read-only dynamic CPU/GPU frequency observations; EMC denied; no energy measurement; no clock control
trace_artifacts: raw requests and process telemetry under /tmp/e6-ninfer-fixed-5k; route IDs only retained in ~/models; prompt/completion text excluded from repository
